Smruti Rekha Batu Senior Analyst – Market Data Operations Mobile: +91 99809 94464 Email: Puhhbatu33@gmail.com 32, 1st Main Road, Anjappa Layout, Mahadevapura, Bangalore - 16

Professional Summary Market Data Operations professional with 6 years of experience across financial operations and market data administration, including 4+ years specializing in entitlement management, DACS administration, exchange reporting, and vendor governance within global banking environments. Proven track record managing end-to-end user lifecycle (provisioning through de-provisioning), invoice reconciliation, license harvesting, and audit-ready compliance documentation for 10,000+ users across Bloomberg, Refinitiv, and exchange platforms including NASDAQ, NYSE, OPRA, CBOE, ICE, HKEX, and LSE. Strong record of SLA-driven delivery, vendor cost optimization, and cross-functional stakeholder management. Core Competenices

Domain Expertise: BFSI, Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Financial Markets, Market Data Services Market Data and Licensing Operations: Entitlement Management, License Management (Named User and

Concurrent), Display and Non-Display Licensing, License Harvesting, Access Certification, Market Data Inventory Management, Exchange Reporting and EMRS, Exchange Fee Management and Billing, Cost Allocation and Chargeback Methodology, Contract and Vendor Audit Support

Regulatory and Governance: Data Governance, Data Quality, Controls and Compliance, Risk Management,

Operational Risk, Regulatory Compliance, Consumption Monitoring, Control Validation

Process and Stakeholder Management: SLA Management, Incident and Exception Management, Root Cause

Analysis, Continuous Improvement, Process Optimization, Stakeholder Management, Cross-functional Collaboration, Documentation and SOP

Tools and Platforms: Bloomberg Terminal, Bloomberg DACS, Bloomberg BPIPE, Bloomberg EMRS, Refinitiv Eikon,

LSEG Workspace, FITS, MDSL, Calero, ServiceNow, RPM Workflow

Technical Skills: Advanced Excel (VBA and Macros, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/HLOOKUP), Power Query, Process

Automation, Vendor Management, AI-Assisted Workflows (Microsoft Copilot)

Professional Experience Blackstone Senior Analyst, Market Data Operations

May 2025 – Present

Own end-to-end market data operations for 10,000 plus users on the Blackstone account, spanning entitlement administration, vendor billing, inventory governance via FITS, and exchange reporting and declarations across NASDAQ, NYSE, OPRA, and CBOE.

Validate monthly vendor invoices against contracts and entitlements; manage cost allocation across business units

and cost centers, cutting unnecessary vendor spend by 10%.

Process 400 plus monthly MAC requests including onboarding, entitlement upgrades, cancellations, and offboarding

with full approval compliance and zero audit findings.

Administer Bloomberg Terminal and BPIPE entitlements, validating license availability and business justification

against vendor agreements.

Drive entitlement audits, access certifications, and license harvesting, improving license utilization by 15% and

reducing renewal spend.

Act as primary contact for Finance, Procurement, and vendor teams on renewals and billing disputes; resolve incidents

via ServiceNow within SLA, owning audit-trail documentation for compliance reviews.

HSBC Senior Market Data Analyst

Nov 2022 – Apr 2025

Managed daily market data administration for 800 plus users across Investment Banking and Financial Markets,

covering Bloomberg, Refinitiv Eikon, and other platforms via RPM Workflow.

Processed 80 plus monthly provisioning and deprovisioning requests, consistently meeting SLA targets for entitlement

turnaround.

Owned daily DACS administration including entitlement setup, access changes, and license control, and maintained

inventory governance via MDSL, keeping records audit-ready at all times.

Managed cost allocation and invoice tracking via Calero, reconciling entitlements across vendor platforms and request

records to maintain licensing accuracy.

Managed exchange declarations and EMRS reporting for display and non-display usage across NASDAQ, NYSE,

OPRA, CBOE, ICE, HKEX, and LSE, ensuring full regulatory alignment. Investigated provisioning delays, entitlement errors, and billing anomalies via root cause analysis; supplied usage and consumption data that informed vendor renewals and reduced repeat incidents by 20%.

United Parcel Services (UPS) Assistant Analyst, Financial Operations

Aug 2020 – Aug 2022

Processed high-volume accounts payable and receivable transactions, validating invoices, payment requests, and approvals before release; resolved outstanding balances and reconciliation issues across customer accounts.

Verified wire transfer and ACH payment processing, including banking instructions, transaction accuracy, and

approval status, before execution.

Prepared invoice allocation reports mapping expenses to cost centers, business units, and accounting categories for

accurate financial tracking.

Reconciled invoices, payments, and transaction records to identify mismatches and exceptions, closing discrepancies

within 2 business days.

Built KPI reports and operational dashboards in Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Macros) for business

monitoring and performance tracking.

Documented process workflows and SOPs, improving consistency and compliance with financial controls.

Education

Master of Business Administration, Finance and Marketing Ravenshaw University, Cuttack, India | 2020
